bio_en: Hovhannes Ghazarian of Pasen, known as Zulumat, was born to a mother living in exile and early took the thorny path of the freedom fighter, becoming a comrade of Aghbyur Serob. In spring 1907 his small band defended a monastery village and the surrounding Persian villages, and Kurdish songs celebrated his courage. He took part in the Persian constitutional struggle, in which the ARF fought with large forces. He was killed in February 1911 at the village of Bedghavar near Khoy, on the historic plain of Avarayr, in a battle between the constitutionalists and government forces.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium.
